important_methodology_notes: This is a demonstration dataset. Student names, phone numbers, email addresses, addresses, semester-level subject records, and fee records are synthetic.
Department values were reassigned cyclically to CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, AIDS, AIML to meet the requested demo scenario; these are not original department labels from the source CSV.
All records were assigned Semester 5 and Academic_Year 2025-2026 for the project demonstration.

The source contains one attendance and marks record per student, not subject-level records. Five subject-level attendance/examination rows per student were generated by applying documented small deterministic variations to source attendance and marks.

Internal marks are derived from assignment/midterm marks and scaled to 40; external marks are derived from final marks and scaled to 60. Grades are generated from total marks using project-defined bands.
Fees are synthetic demo values; scholarship recipients receive a 10000 reduction in total semester fees before payment status is generated.
The source had missing Attendance, Study_Hours, and Scholarship values; these were imputed with median Attendance/Study_Hours and No for Scholarship. The original source file is not modified.
